description: The AI app builder of this workspace: builder credits left (plan credits and pack credits, the monthly amount), the credit price of each action (design, first app, small and large edit, builds), and the builder apps (id, name, status DRAFT, DESIGNED, GENERATED). With app (an id from this list): its AI steps (DESIGN, GENERATE, EDIT with status QUEUED, RUNNING, SUCCEEDED, FAILED; credits used, refunded = true when a step failed and its credits came back, fix attempts, the error), its builds (platform, where it ran, status, credits, refunded), and where the next iOS and Android builds can run with plain cost words: github = Your GitHub (the customer pays their own GitHub Actions minutes, 0 credits), eas_own = Your Expo account (billed by Expo, 0 credits), eas_ours = AppForShare on Expo (credits), self_hosted = AppForShare Linux (Android only, credits); options that are not possible now say why. appleSigning = the saved Apple signing for iOS builds on eas_ours: source workspace (the workspace re-signing certificate is reused, only the profile is per app) or app (the app's own .p12), certificate and profile names and expiry, stale = true when the workspace certificate was replaced after the profile was saved (names and expiry only; it is added in the dashboard, never through this tool). workspaceCertificate = the workspace re-signing certificate and whether it can sign builds. Apps have a kind: MOBILE (Expo, iOS and Android) or WEB (Vite + React site). comments = comments on the design screens (screenId, author, fromClient = written by a client on an approval link, resolved). approvalLinks = client approval links (Pro and Team; open links per app depend on the plan): label, url, state open, revoked or expired, views, the client decision APPROVED or CHANGES_REQUESTED with onCurrentDesign = false when the design changed since. WEB apps: webPreview.url = the current version on its own preview address (every plan; null while previews are off on the server; previews are a test host with a bar on every page, only the current and the previous version keep one), webPreview.switchedOff = true when a Free preview was switched off after webPreview.idleDays without a new version (a new version or an edit turns it back on), webPreview.usage = preview traffic this UTC month in bytes against the plan allowance (over it the preview shows an allowance page until next month), and deploy = the deploy checklist (version, hosting provider netlify or vercel, provider token saved (never shown), domain and DNS records with the live check, public env variables the code reads, secret names only), ready, and the last deploys (status, url, mock = test mode where nothing was uploaded, refunded). aiPausedUntil = set while new AI steps of the workspace wait because too many failed in 24 hours (their credits were given back); say the time. MOBILE apps: mobilePreview = the current version running in the browser (react-native-web, shown in a phone frame on the app page): url (null until ready), status PENDING or BUILDING (about a minute), READY, FAILED with error (the app itself still passed its checks), liveContent = CMSCure texts and lists load live in it; same allowance and switch off rules as web previews. Without app: packs = the credit packs (credits and price in USD cents; Pro and Team, features.creditPacks; bought by the workspace owner in the dashboard, App builder, never through this tool), canBuyPacks, nudges = plain plan notes at a limit (apps used, credits low or out) with where to go; repeat them in words, do not push. Read only. Every plan with an account; Your GitHub and Your Expo account work on every plan for iOS and Android, eas_ours is Pro and Team.
